payout_quote: To receive the $500 checking bonus, open a new business checking account, deposit $50 or more at account opening, and have at least a $3,000 balance 90 days from the date of account opening.
steps: Open a new Central Bank (The Central Trust Bank) business checking account, bringing the mailer or using the published offer code (deal sites cite code 500BB21).
Deposit $50 or more at account opening.
Have at least a $3,000 balance 90 days from the date of account opening.
Receive the $500 bonus deposited into the business checking account within 15 business days after all requirements are met AND the account has been open for 90 days.
catches: Official terms say the offer may only be redeemed by the intended recipient and is nontransferable — but the page is public and accepts the published offer code, so anyone eligible can redeem it with the code.
Not valid in Florida or Colorado, and Central Bank reserves the right not to open accounts for customers outside its market area.
New business checking customers only; not available to anyone whose accounts were closed with a negative balance within the last 2 years.
One bonus per customer, and only one new-checking-account opening bonus every two years from the last date an incentive was paid.
If the checking account is closed within the first 90 days, a fee may be imposed; the account must be open and in good standing when the bonus is paid.
Central Bank employees are not eligible.
Bonus is reported to the IRS as interest (taxable).
biggest_catch: Only ,000 parked for 90 days earns the full 00, but the terms say the offer is only redeemable by the intended recipient and nontransferable — the public offer-code path is what makes it broadly usable, so bring/use the code at account opening.
eligibility: New Central Bank business checking customers within the bank's market area (not valid in FL or CO); not available to those whose accounts were closed with a negative balance in the last 2 years; employees excluded.
timing: Promotion ends 11/30/26; $3,000+ balance required 90 days from account opening; bonus paid within 15 business days after requirements are met and the account has been open 90 days.
